status: Prospective freeze; official test inputs and targets have not been opened by this study.
scope: Bounded supervised neural perception on already segmented 8 by 8 digits. This is a new task-specific spiking specialist, separate from the original 1,024-cell recurrent circuit. No result about general OCR, consciousness, market decisions, treasury choices or hiring is claimed.

data.upstream_partition: Different training and test writers; per-row writer identifiers are unavailable.

task.inputs: Exactly 64 integer pixel summaries in 0..16, normalized by 16. No augmentation, crop selection or omitted test examples.
task.actions: Ten integer digit labels in 0..9. Equal logits resolve toward the lowest class index.
task.feedback: Official supervised training labels. Qualification inference cannot update weights or optimizer. Test targets reach scoring only after all registered predictions and identity checks are complete.

selection.development: Fixed stratified 3,060/763 split inside official training data, seed 20261024. All architectures, epochs, initializations and linear-grid outcomes are retained. kNN5 wins development; superiority over every method is not assumed.
selection.neural: 64 hidden LIF cells and 16 discrete ticks: v = 0.8*v + drive; fire at v >= 1; subtract one on reset. Hard spike fractions feed the action readout. Conventional Adam and the explicit bounded surrogate train weights.

training.order_seed_rule: numpy default_rng(model seed + 707); fresh permutation each epoch; identical order across matched mechanisms
training.training_labels: All 3823 published training labels are visible to every fitted method; qualification labels never train these checkpoints

selection.seed_aggregation: Mean accuracy of three fixed initializations on the same 1,797 images. These are not 5,391 independent examples, and no best seed may be selected from test scores.
selection.primary_control: Development-selected regularized linear softmax, with the same 64 pixels and all 3,823 training labels.
selection.learning_control: Same architecture and output learning, with input weights frozen at initialization. Each seed, training order and label budget is matched.
other_controls: Matched continuous clipped-rate hidden network, with three fixed initializations.

gates.neural_over_linear: Mean accuracy at least one percentage point above the frozen linear control, with every neural initialization strictly better.
gates.learned_input_contribution: Mean accuracy at least one percentage point above matched input-frozen models, with every initialization strictly better than its matched control.
gates.interpretation: Passing establishes finite-benchmark improvement over the declared linear and output-only controls. kNN and continuous results remain prominent regardless of outcome; passing does not imply beating those methods.

mechanistic_checks.full_set: Independent hard-spike, count, logit and label arithmetic for all six spiking branches, before targets are read.
mechanistic_checks.brian2: Actual Brian2 Euler threshold/reset reference on the first eight official inputs in each spiking branch. Spike counts and labels must agree exactly; continuous membrane tolerance is disclosed.
mechanistic_checks.interventions: Zero actual spike features and restore initial input synapses while retaining the trained readout. Report all three trained models; no intervention selection or tuning after test scores.

metrics: Every branch has correct/incorrect counts and exact matched wins/losses versus linear and kNN5.
Inference CPU seconds and complete checkpoint bytes are separate observations, not energy or speed claims.
All 1,797 examples and eleven models remain in the denominator; failures cannot be excluded after inspection.
uncertainty: Exact fixed-benchmark observations. Writer identifiers are unavailable, so no writer-cluster intervals or assertion of 1,797 independent writers is made. Training and execution are not externally witnessed. No first-ever claim is made.
access_and_reruns: One official qualification after exact public GitHub protocol-byte verification. Every prediction is synced to disk before targets are parsed. A fitted-model or frozen-source change invalidates this qualification; preserve every failed attempt. Deterministic reproduction is labelled as reproduction, not another unseen experiment.
